$description: The white-label contract. Every file in tokens/brands/ must define exactly these token paths. Semantic tokens only reach brand values through these paths, so a new brand is a single file.
rules: Step 600 is the light-mode fill (buttons, chips). It must reach 4.5:1 against white text.
Step 300 is the dark-mode fill. It must reach 4.5:1 against primitive.color.neutral.900 text.
Steps 50 and 900 are subtle backgrounds (light / dark). Step 700 / 300 text must reach 4.5:1 on them.
Brand values may be literals or references to primitive tokens. They may not reference semantic tokens.
Contrast is enforced by `npm run validate` using tokens/contrast-pairs.json.
